_comment: Loud, documented staleness waivers for the provenance gate (evals/provenance.py). Every entry needs a non-empty reason; remove an entry the moment the artifact is regenerated. Current entries: the 2026-08-10 hta.org domain move and the three agencies added on 2026-08-12 (Elk Grove e-tran, Santa Cruz METRO, SolTrans), all pending the same next promoted eval run.

acknowledged.reason: Four causes, all pending the same regeneration. (1) 2026-08-10: hta-fares source domain moved (humboldttransit.org now 404s; site relocated to hta.org). The refetch rebound corpus_version 0938fff0539a to 35ec70d6359d; the refresh report confirmed no policy-text change, only the source URL and fetch metadata. (2) 2026-08-12: Elk Grove Transit Services (e-tran) added as the sixth agency (etran-fares, etran-senior-pass). (3) 2026-08-12: Santa Cruz METRO (SCMTD) added as the seventh agency (scmtd-fares-passes, scmtd-accessibility, scmtd-tap2cruz); merging (2) and (3) rebound corpus_version to feb21f02c510. (4) 2026-08-12: SolTrans (Solano County Transit) added as the eighth agency, four documents (soltrans-fare-table, soltrans-clipper-card, soltrans-ways-to-pay, soltrans-paperless-fares), rebinding corpus_version once more to 5e6a24ef0702 (20 documents, 140 chunks), which is what HEAD now ships. Unlike (1), causes (2) through (4) are all new policy text: the committed scores were computed against a corpus containing none of the three agencies. They remain valid for the cases they cover and say nothing at all about the new E-tran, SCMTD, or SolTrans cases, none of which has ever been scored live. Regenerate all three artifacts at the next promoted live eval run and remove these entries.
